report.explanation: All current telemetry is healthy: one OK payment checkout span (61ms), gateway error_rate 0.0012 and p95 73ms, zero dependency timeouts and pool waiters, and an INFO 200 order log. The order 3.1.1 deployment is 637 minutes old with valid config, and a deployment record alone cannot establish latency causation. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause, so no bounded candidate can be stated; hand off for the missing per-service data.
missing_evidence: Per-service error rates and latency for order, inventory, payment, and gateway over the alert window
Trace spans covering the full checkout path (gateway->order->inventory/payment/postgresql), not a single OK payment span
Logs showing any error, timeout, or 5xx events during the alert window
Dependency timeout and connection-pool metrics for order, inventory, and payment
Redis and postgresql health/latency metrics to test redis-timeout and db-pool-exhaustion
